DIV5.HEAD: PART 262—STANDARDS APPLICABLE TO GENERATORS OF HAZARDOUS WASTE (SAMPLE)

DIV8.HEAD: § 262.10 Purpose, scope, and applicability.
DIV8.P: (a) Purpose. This part establishes the sample standards for generators of hazardous waste.
(b) Scope. A generator must determine whether its waste is hazardous. See paragraph (a) of this section.

DIV8.HEAD: § 262.11 Hazardous waste determination and recordkeeping.
DIV8.P: (a) A person who generates a solid waste must determine if that waste is a hazardous waste.

EXTRACT.P: (1) Sample extract paragraph with a reference.

DIV8.HEAD: § 262.32 Marking.
DIV8.P: (a) Before transporting, a generator must mark each container.
